claims.text: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service protecting sensitive data and browsing privacy

quote.text: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service that protects your sensitive data and keeps your browsing private.

claims.text: Guarantees a secure connection to stay safe from hackers

quote.text: GOOSE VPN guarantees that you’ll have a secure connection, so you can stay safe from hackers.

claims.text: Encrypts internet activity and routes it through a remote server for private browsing

quote.text: Because this tool encrypts your internet activity and then routes it through a remote server, you’ll be able to browse the web privately.

claims.text: Uses military-grade encryption to protect online privacy and internet security

quote.text: Using military-grade encryption, GOOSE VPN is able to protect your online privacy and internet security.

claims.text: Kill switch and double VPN kick in if VPN server connection fails

quote.text: If your connection to the VPN server fails, the kill switch and double VPN will kick in to protect your anonymity.

claims.text: Cyber Alarm analyzes activity and sends real-time notifications about malware risks

quote.text: Best of all, the Cyber Alarm analyzes your activity and sends real-time notifications about potential risks, like malware, ransomware, and viruses.

claims.text: Lets you browse any part of the internet and bypass geo-restricted content

quote.text: GOOSE VPN lets you browse any part of the internet, so you can say goodbye to geo-restricted content.

claims.text: Online activity is always hidden from ISPs without tracking

quote.text: And because your online activity is always hidden from ISPs, you can surf the world wide web without being tracked.

claims.text: No-logging policy means data is never collected or stored

quote.text: Thanks to GOOSE VPN’s no-logging policy, you can rest easy knowing that your data is never collected or stored.

claims.text: App works on all devices including Android, iOS, Windows, and Linux

quote.text: No matter your skill level, you’ll be able to use the GOOSE VPN app on all your devices, including Android, iOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems.

trials.reasoning: The defense confirms unlimited devices only, while fewer than 25 countries does not prove fewer than 100 servers and slow speed does not prove a bandwidth cap, so the full Tier 3 claim is neither confirmed nor directly contradicted.

exhibits.argument: Fewer than 25 countries contradicts the claim of 100+ servers worldwide.

exhibits.argument: Unusable slowdown undermines the claim of unlimited bandwidth.

exhibits.quote: option to use unlimited devices under one subscription — a huge plus for families or people with multiple gadgets 📱💻.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the unlimited-devices benefit described in the Tier 3 claim.

trials.claim: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service protecting sensitive data and browsing privacy
trials.claimQuote: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service that protects your sensitive data and keeps your browsing private.
trials.reasoning: Two reviews report IP leaking and DNS leaks, which directly conflict with protecting sensitive data and keeping browsing private, outweighing one generic positive review.

exhibits.quote: just discovered my IP is leaking like a busted pipe, which defeats the entire purpose of having a VPN
exhibits.argument: IP leaking directly contradicts protection of sensitive data and browsing privacy.

exhibits.quote: Dutch servers are frequently unavailable, have DNS leaks, and I can't get the IKEv2 protocol to work
exhibits.argument: DNS leaks contradict the claim of secure private browsing.

exhibits.quote: Goose VPN is a simple yet powerful VPN service that offers users a safe and reliable way to browse the internet 🌐🔒.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms GOOSE VPN provides a safe and reliable way to browse the internet.

trials.claim: Guarantees a secure connection to stay safe from hackers
trials.claimQuote: GOOSE VPN guarantees that you’ll have a secure connection, so you can stay safe from hackers.
trials.reasoning: Reviews report the VPN not connecting, disconnecting within seconds, or causing loss of all internet, directly conflicting with a guaranteed secure connection.

exhibits.quote: Doesn't connect and when it does, it disconnects within 6-secs
exhibits.argument: Failure to stay connected contradicts the guarantee of a secure connection.

exhibits.quote: When I turn it on I lose all internet connection, the app as far as I can see has not been updated since I purchased it.
exhibits.argument: Losing all internet when turned on contradicts staying safe via secure connection.

exhibits.quote: 🦢 Goose VPN – The Easy Way to Stay Safe Online 🌐.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms GOOSE VPN keeps users safe online as claimed.

trials.claim: Encrypts internet activity and routes it through a remote server for private browsing
trials.claimQuote: Because this tool encrypts your internet activity and then routes it through a remote server, you’ll be able to browse the web privately.
trials.reasoning: Defense reviews confirm solid encryption and routing traffic through GOOSE VPN IP addresses; detection or flagged IPs show blocking issues but do not contradict that encryption and remote routing occur.

exhibits.quote: More of the same, it does the basics but VPN detectors still notice it and block it.
exhibits.argument: Being detected and blocked undermines private browsing via remote server.

exhibits.quote: The service frequently connects me to IP addresses that are flagged for malicious activity, which causes issues like being blocked by Google.
exhibits.argument: Flagged IP addresses undermine the claim of private browsing through remote servers.

exhibits.quote: The app ensures strong security with solid encryption, giving peace of mind when using public Wi-Fi networks ☕📶.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the app provides strong security with solid encryption.

exhibits.quote: until goose vpn changes their ip addresses through which they route traffic.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms GOOSE VPN routes traffic through its IP addresses.
